data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Why do Israel and Lebanon hate each other? ASSISTANT:

Israel and Lebanon have had a long history of tension and conflict dating back to the establishment of the State of Israel in 1948. This is due to a number of factors including disputed border regions, competing national interests, and past military conflicts.
